card.name: Just before drug names or doses
card.fires_on: Strongly negative on a word, space or partial word just before a drug name or dose amount, such as inside a new drug name or after 'containing' or 'include'. It appears in drug-label text.

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: Inside a long drug name, where more name pieces follow.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: A word like include, containing or with that leads into a named drug.
modes.example: which<< include>> the everyday drug clindamycin.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A bare space just before a concentration or amount.

card.plain: It fires on the spot right before a drug name or dose amount is spelled out.
evidence: which<< include>> the everyday drug clindamycin.
